Doge Jewish Cemetery One

Jewish Cemetery · Döge, Hungary

Not demolished. NOTE: the source page's historical narrative for this record was found to duplicate the unrelated Mándok Jewish Cemetery entry word-for-word (confirmed on both jewishcemeteries.eu and the underlying ESJF survey page), so that text is not used here. What can be said reliably: Döge's Jewish community is first recorded in an 1770 census (4 residents), growing to 97 people across 23 households by 1848 before declining steadily - 51 by 1910, 17 by 1930 - with no Jews remaining by 1949. An 1848 document records the village's Jewish cemetery covering roughly 2 acres. Beyond this general village history, no reliable cemetery-specific founding date is available for this particular record, and sources disagree on the site's exact address.
